title: Why Origen examined heretics and philosophers
english: Since I was devoted to the Word, and the report about our condition was spreading, heretics came to me at times, and at other times those trained in Greek learning, and especially those in philosophy. So I decided to examine both the doctrines of the heretics and what the philosophers claimed to teach about truth. I did this in imitation of Pantaenus, who before us helped many people and had considerable preparation in these matters, and also of Heraclas, who now sits in the presbyterate of Alexandria. I found him studying under the teacher of philosophy, where he had already persevered with him for five years before I began to hear those lectures. Because of this, he had taken off the common clothing he was wearing and put on the philosopher's garb, which he keeps to this day, and he does not cease studying the books of the Greeks according to his ability.
